QSR dashboard ↗ B2D dashboard ↗
Data till 16:42 IST, 04 Nov 2026
Today + yesterday · rows are the exact RTOs/vehicles that failed with a mapping-not-found error, deduped and summed — each row is an actionable gap to add to the insurer's config, not just an error count. Missing RTOs/MMVs are insurer-config gaps; Redis cache-miss categories are a different failure class (data missing from the Redis cache used at quote time, not a config gap) — split into RTO- and vehicle-flavoured misses, since the identical "Redis Data not found" message text only distinguishes them via error_code. Click a category to expand its rows (sorted worst-first); "Download all VRNs" on each card exports every row for that insurer, uncapped.
